_doc: The Order of the World. tier 1 = highest. dockLight = color of dock lamps that accept this tier and above (a dock accepts tiers <= its standingMax). priceMod multiplies shop prices for a customer of this tier (shops may override). patrol = how Tide Ward stops treat this tier. tone = default NPC register. wristband = HUD/world color.

1.name: Concord
1.desc: Highmark's ruling families. Never seen on the rafts.

2.name: Highmark Citizen
2.desc: Archivists, physicians, engineers, provisioners. Steady rations, housing, fear of losing it all.

3.name: Tide Ward
3.desc: Marshal, captains, wardens, deckhands. Many are raft-born conscripts.

4.name: Licensed Trader
4.desc: Raft-born with a Highmark permit. Outer Harbor access, cheaper fuel. Raft-folk call them informers.

5.name: Raft-folk
5.desc: Free crew of the raft cities. Reduced rations tied to labour and loyalty.

6.name: Drifter
6.desc: Solo boaters and exiles. No bracelet. Night markets only.

7.name: Deep-Born
7.desc: Divers and salvagers. The only ones who go beneath. Needed, feared, kept at a distance.

drifter_tag.desc: Cut your Deep-Born tally off and wear nothing. Orange docks open; the divers will say you're ashamed of them.

trader_permit.desc: A yellow Highmark permit. Green and yellow docks, cheaper fuel, friendlier patrols. You'll be expected to report what you see.

forgery.desc: A forged tag shows a higher tier until someone checks it against the Ward's ledger.
